meta.title: King Solomon Kalyves | Luxury Sea-View Villas for Sale in Crete
meta.description: 21 cliffside luxury villas for sale in Kalyves, Chania, each with a private pool and 270° sea views. Fully furnished and professionally managed. Book a private presentation.

hero.title: Own the horizon.
hero.subtitle: Twenty-one private villas, each with its own pool, rising 34 metres above the Cretan Sea.

intro.title: Some places you visit. Others stay with you.
intro.lead: King Solomon sits where the mountains of western Crete step down to meet the sea. Behind you, the White Mountains. Before you, an unbroken sweep of Mediterranean blue. Every evening ends in gold.
intro.text: This is not another holiday home by the beach. It is a private world on the cliff edge, composed of architecture, light and silence. Mornings open to the sound of the sea below. Afternoons slow down beside your own pool. Nights belong to the stars over Souda Bay.

concept.title: Elevation, turned into emotion.
concept.text: Everything at King Solomon begins with a single idea: the sensation of rising above it all. Above the noise, above routine, above the ordinary seaside development. Set on a rare first-line cliff, each villa is a self-contained Mediterranean sanctuary with its own pool, outdoor living, private entrance and an open line to the sea.
concept.quote: The architecture does not compete with the view. It frames it.

points.title: First line, on the cliff
points.text: Nothing between your terrace and the sea but 70 metres of air.

points.title: Privacy by design
points.text: Independent entrances, planted terraces and a gated, controlled compound.

points.title: Hotel standard, home feeling
points.text: Delivered fully designed, furnished and equipped, ready for your first evening.

collections.title: Four ways to live above the sea.
collections.text: From a one-bedroom rooftop hideaway to a five-bedroom garden villa on two levels, every residence is handed over complete: designed, furnished and ready to enjoy or to rent.

rooftop.title: Rooftop residences
rooftop.text: Your own sky terrace above the Mediterranean. Pool, outdoor kitchen and lounge on a private roof that turns every sunset into an occasion.

garden.title: Garden residences
garden.text: Private gardens that flow straight from the living room, a pool a few steps away and planted terraces that protect your privacy on the slope.

resort.title: A private resort on the edge of the sea.
resort.text: Beyond your own villa, an entire cliffside resort is reserved for owners and their guests.

items.title: Cliff-edge infinity pool
items.text: A 10 × 4 m infinity pool aimed straight at the horizon, with sunbeds, cabana lounges and an eight-person jacuzzi.

items.title: Spa & wellness club
items.text: Fitness studio, glass-walled sauna, treatment room and a quiet space for yoga, pilates and meditation.

items.title: Panoramic glass elevator
items.text: A glass lift glides from the upper entrance down to the pool level. A dramatic arrival, and true comfort on a cliff.

items.title: Steps to the sea
items.text: Around 30 to 40 steps lead from the resort to the seafront, the promenade and the tavernas of Kalyves. No car needed.

items.title: Sun deck & lounges
items.text: Shared terraces, sunbathing decks and hosting areas designed for long afternoons in golden light.

items.title: Gated & secure
items.text: Three controlled entrances, cameras and facial-recognition access. Closed to the public, open to the view.

turnkey.title: Not a shell. A finished villa.
turnkey.text: Each villa is delivered with a complete interior concept by an architect and interior designer, imported furniture, a real residential kitchen, smart access and a boutique-hotel furnishing package. Ready for your first evening, or your first guest.

management.title: You own it. We look after everything else.
management.text: King Solomon is operated by Sivan Management, our on-site team in Chania, available around the clock. From the shared facilities and villa care to housekeeping and optional short-term rentals, everything is handled, with every figure visible in the owner app.

items.title: Rental & yield management
items.text: Optional listing on Booking.com and Airbnb, dynamic pricing, guest communication and check-in.

items.title: Villa care
items.text: Scheduled inspections of pools, systems and smart access, so your villa is always ready.

items.title: Owner transparency
items.text: Bookings, income statements and maintenance status, live in the app.

items.title: Concierge
items.text: Private chef, transfers, car hire, restaurant reservations and spa treatments on request.

invest.title: A rare asset in a market that keeps rising.

items.title: European security
items.text: Greek property law, EU banking standards and a transparent notarial purchase process.

items.title: Irreplaceable position
items.text: First-line cliff plots with protected sea views are, by nature, impossible to replicate.

items.title: Hands-off ownership
items.text: Professional on-site management and optional rental, so the villa works while you are away.

items.title: Months of season
items.text: Western Crete enjoys one of the longest holiday seasons in Europe, from spring until late autumn.

faq.q: What exactly is included in the villa?
faq.a: Every villa is delivered with the full design and furnishing package: an interior concept by an architect and interior designer, imported furniture, a fully equipped kitchen with premium appliances, a private pool and an outdoor kitchen. It is handed over ready to live in, or ready for its first guest. The current price list is available on request.

faq.q: Can I rent the villa out when I am not there?
faq.a: Yes, if you wish. Sivan Management runs the resort with a 24/7 local team and offers full short-term rental management: listing on Booking.com and Airbnb, dynamic pricing, guest check-in, housekeeping and transparent reporting in the owner app. Participation is entirely optional.

faq.q: How does the purchase process work?
faq.a: It starts with an introductory call and a private presentation with the current price list. You then reserve your villa with a reservation agreement, and we coordinate the Greek lawyer, the notary and, if required, local bank financing. Our team accompanies you at every step, all the way to the keys.
Of course. We arrange private presentations at our office in Chania or online. The site is about 22 minutes from Chania International Airport and 12 minutes from the old town.

faq.q: Can foreign buyers purchase property in Greece?
faq.a: Yes. EU citizens buy on the same terms as Greek citizens, and buyers from outside the EU can also acquire property. For non-EU buyers, the Greek Golden Visa residency programme applies to a property investment of €800,000 or more, and selected King Solomon villas meet this threshold. Our team and partner lawyers will review your eligibility personally.

Greece has double taxation treaties with many countries, including Israel, Germany, France, Spain and the United Kingdom, designed to prevent the same income being taxed twice. The implications depend on your personal situation, so we coordinate a review with qualified accountants and tax lawyers.
